description: An MCP server that gives AI agents a wallet they can only spend inside a human-granted written policy: per-transaction and daily caps, recipient allowlists, approval thresholds, expiry, and an instant, timestamped kill switch. The anti-Section-15: Wells Fargo makes your agent legally you with no controls; this wallet makes the agent's authority exactly the scope you granted — and proves it with an append-only audit log.
